tests.name: Schema and all five admission batches execute
Before first admission the system knows no value
K2: June 4 was believed unarchived
K3: correction changes June 4 interpretation to archived
K4: contradictory evidence produces disputed, not false
K5: resolution restores an accepted value
Half-open boundary belongs to the new state
No evidence before world-valid start returns unknown
Expired freshness does not change accepted truth value
Freshness is evaluated with the supplied clock
Timeline clips to requested time1/time2
Timeline emits unknown uncovered interval
Empty historical snapshot returns one unknown span
Tenant-scoped reads cannot find another tenant repository
Historical K2 interpretation survives every later change
Correction lineage references the precise earlier segment
Mutating old world intervals is rejected
Deleting an admission is rejected
Late evidence attachment to a sealed revision is rejected
Retroactive segment insertion in a sealed batch is rejected
Stale admission head requires rebase
Overlapping canonical states in one revision are rejected
Empty state intervals are rejected
Accepted belief requires a typed value
Disputed belief cannot masquerade as Boolean false
Evidence-free fixture admission is rejected
Failed admission leaves committed head unchanged
Uncertain change boundary is preserved as a window
Point observation has no fabricated world-valid interval
Unknown temporal extent does not become an infinite range
Mixed exact and uncertain representations are rejected
Tenant-composite FK rejects foreign entity references

limitations: No production RLS or ingestion-service proof
